source keeps the text in one paragraph while the page builder sends the remaining fragment to page
3. This arrangement makes the continuation easy to inspect. Automatic hyphenation usually han-
dles normal documents, where later edits can change line lengths and page positions. Here the fixed

lex example. Page 3 begins with this fragment. Nothing appears above it. The paragraph keeps the
